name: Keraton at The Plaza
short_description: A 138-room all-club luxury hotel within the Plaza Indonesia complex, marking The Unbound Collection by Hyatt's Southeast Asia debut in December 2024.
ai_summary: Keraton at The Plaza reopened in December 2024 within the Plaza Indonesia complex, marking the Southeast Asia debut of The Unbound Collection by Hyatt, after the property had been closed for nearly five years. Rooms run a spacious 64 square metres with 12-foot ceilings, and the hotel operates as an all-club property with breakfast, lunch, afternoon tea, and evening canapes included for every stay. Guests consistently describe the atmosphere as serene and luxurious, with genuinely personal service, and its direct connection to Plaza Indonesia and proximity to the Bundaran HI MRT station make it one of the most centrally located luxury hotels in Jakarta.

core_facts.address: Plaza Indonesia, Jalan M.H. Thamrin Kav 28-30, Jakarta 10350, Indonesia
elite_benefits: All-club service (breakfast, lunch, afternoon tea, and evening canapes) included with every stay
Room upgrades for Explorist and Globalist Elite members, subject to availability, per World of Hyatt program terms
Late check-out until 4pm for Globalist Elite members, subject to availability

pros: Reopened December 2024 as The Unbound Collection by Hyatt's Southeast Asia debut
All-club service included with every stay: breakfast, lunch, afternoon tea, and evening canapes
Spacious 64-square-metre rooms with 12-foot ceilings and floor-to-ceiling windows
Directly connected to Plaza Indonesia mall, near the Bundaran HI MRT station
A connecting passage to Grand Hyatt Jakarta's wellness facilities, including tennis courts and a Balinese garden pool
cons: As a recently reopened property under new Hyatt management, it has a shorter track record under this branding than Jakarta's longer-established luxury hotels
research_highlights: Guests consistently describe the atmosphere as serene, luxurious, and immaculately clean
The all-club dining, including breakfast, lunch, and evening canapes, draws strong praise
Service is repeatedly called personal and welcoming rather than merely professional
research_watchouts: No significant recurring watchouts surfaced across recent reviews

faqs.question: Is Keraton at The Plaza an all-inclusive hotel?
faqs.answer: It operates as an all-club property, meaning breakfast, lunch, afternoon tea, and evening canapes are included with every stay -- not the full food-and-drink-inclusive model of a resort, but more included dining than a typical city luxury hotel.

faqs.question: What loyalty program is Keraton at The Plaza part of?
faqs.answer: It's part of The Unbound Collection by Hyatt, joining World of Hyatt after reopening in December 2024 -- the brand's debut property in Southeast Asia, following a period when the hotel had been closed for nearly five years.
